tools.name: list_brush_presets
tools.title: List brushes
tools.description: Lists the brush library (built-in presets and saved brushes) that this host (Paint editor) can render, filtered by kind, medium, variety, tool, tag or words. Returns each brush's id (for describe_brush, create_brush basedOn, duplicate_brush and the editor's set_brush), name, builtin, kind, medium, variety or tool, category, engine, tip shape and size, marks, surface and light, plus total. Call it first to find the nearest brush to start from. Changes nothing.

kind.description: mark (lays a material) or tool (works on paint already down).

text.description: Words in the id, name, description, variety or tags (each word must match the start of one).

source.description: all (default), builtin presets only, or user (saved) brushes only.

all.description: Also list brushes this host can't render, each with renderable false (default false).

tools.name: describe_brush
tools.title: Describe a brush
tools.description: Reads one brush by id: its full facet spec (kind, medium, variety or tool, tip, marks, dynamics, behaviour, light, motion, colour), whether it is built in, the engine and category it resolves to, and check: what this host (Paint editor) refuses or paints without, each with a fix. Unknown ids are refused with the closest ones. Changes nothing.

id.description: Brush id from list_brush_presets (lowercase letters, digits and dashes).

tools.name: check_brush
tools.title: Check a brush for a host
tools.description: Checks a brush (by id, or a facet spec not yet saved) against a host profile: paint, image, canvas, vector (default this host, paint). Returns ok (no errors), issues (facet, severity error or warning, reason, fix) and, when it is refused, degraded: the brush with the refused facets stripped and what was dropped. Use it before create_brush, or to see whether a brush works in another editor. Changes nothing.

id.description: A brush in the library (give id or brush, not both).

brush.description: A facet brush spec (the create_brush fields, with id and name).

annotations.title: Check a brush for a host

tools.name: export_brushes
tools.title: Export brushes
tools.description: Writes a brush library file (format pixerate-brushes, version 2) of the saved brushes, or of the ids given (built-ins included). Returns the file as JSON, for import_brushes in another library. Changes nothing.

items.description: Brush id from list_brush_presets (lowercase letters, digits and dashes).

ids.description: Only these brushes (default every saved brush).

tools.name: list_brush_sources
tools.title: List brush image sources
tools.description: Lists the image sources in the brush library: the images image tips and image grain are made from. Returns each source's id, ref (source:<id>, for tip.stamps of a stamp tip or tip.grain.source in create_brush / update_brush), name, width and height in px, licence and origin when it has them, and usedBy (the saved brushes that name it), plus total. Built-in grain patterns need no source. Changes nothing.

text.description: Words in the id, name or origin (each word must match the start of one).

tools.name: preview_brush
tools.title: Preview a brush
tools.description: Draws a sample S-stroke with a brush (by id) on a plain background and returns it as an image, to see a brush before painting with it or after create_brush / update_brush. Returns the image plus id, width and height. Changes nothing.

id.description: Brush id from list_brush_presets (lowercase letters, digits and dashes).

color.description: Paint colour #rrggbb (default the brush's own default colour, else #1f2937).

tools.name: create_brush
tools.title: Save a new brush
tools.description: Saves a new brush made of facets (to save an editor's current brush settings, pass the brush get_brush returns), optionally basedOn an existing brush (its facets are copied and the ones given here laid over them: objects merge, lists and values replace). Values are normalised (out-of-range numbers clamped, unused facets dropped, each reported in problems) and checked against this host (Paint editor): a brush it can't render is refused with the facet and fix, and nothing is saved. Returns the new id, the stored brush, the engine it resolves to, problems and warnings (settings this host paints without). Start from the nearest preset (list_brush_presets) rather than from nothing.

id.description: The new brush id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, not taken (list_brush_presets).

basedOn.description: Copy this brush's facets first (a built-in preset or a saved brush).

description.description: What the brush is for, in a sentence.

items.description: A tag: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

kind.description: mark: lays a material (see medium); tool: works on paint already down (see tool).

medium.description: Marks: what it lays. paint (dry, wet or thick), ink, dry (pencil, pastel, charcoal) or spray (airbrush). Descriptive: the tip, marks and behaviour decide how it renders.

variety.description: What kind of the medium: oil, watercolor, gouache, pencil, pastel, charcoal, airbrush, marker, highlighter… A wet brush whose variety is watercolor, gouache or oil paints that medium.

tool.description: Tools: eraser removes paint; blender mixes the colours under the tip; smudge drags paint along; water lays clear water (lifts dried paint with behaviour.wet.rewet); dryer dries wet paint; blow pushes water along; blot takes wet paint up; wet-blend evens out wet pigment; wet-drag drags wet paint.

tip.description: The tip: its shape and the dab it lays. In a patch, shape may be left out to keep it.

shape.description: round, flat, chisel: an ellipse set by roundness and angle (the name is for people); bristle: a tuft of bristles (see bristle); stamp: dabs shaped like a stamp, a sticker or an image source (see stamps), also laid as sprays, objects or particles.

hardness.description: Edge hardness, 0 soft .. 1 hard (default 1). Image-source stamps fade towards their edges below 1.

spacing.description: Dab spacing as a fraction of the diameter: 0.05 smooth, 1 dotted (default 0.1).

angle.description: Tip angle in degrees, counter-clockwise; added to the stroke direction or barrel with dynamics.rotation (default 0).

roundness.description: Roundness: 1 round (default), lower a flat ellipse (pastel, chisel).

opacity.description: Stroke opacity ceiling: overlapping dabs never exceed it (default 1).

flow.description: Build-up per dab towards the opacity: low flow builds softly, like an airbrush (default 1).

blend.description: How the stroke paints onto the layer (default normal). pigment mixes like real paint; multiply darkens like marker ink; watercolor glazes; tint, highlight and shadow recolour, light and shade.

bristle.description: Bristle tips: the tuft. Missing fields take their defaults.

stiffness.description: Stiff bristles follow the tip; soft ones lag and bend into curves at turns (default 0.5).

splay.description: How far pressure spreads the tuft (default 0.5).

thickness.description: Each bristle's line width as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.06).

load.description: Paint per bristle: 1 never runs dry; lower, bristles run out along the stroke, a dry brush (default 0.6).

jitter.description: Random variation between bristles: length, paint, position (default 0.4).

items.description: A sticker ref provider:id (find_stickers lists them; the editor's own are editor:dot, editor:star, editor:heart, editor:leaf, editor:flower, editor:confetti, editor:splat, editor:sparkle, editor:ring), or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources lists them; add_brush_source makes one from an image). A bare editor stamp (star) means editor:star.

stamps.description: Stamp tips: stickers or image sources (source:<id>). Continuous dabs and sprays lay the first; objects take only stickers and pick one at random per mark (default editor:star; repeats count once); particles use the first 4 in marks.stampOrder, and repeats weight the order.

grain.description: Texture inside the tip (a grain source), separate from the paper's grain: each dab is multiplied by it. Continuous and scatter marks of round and stamp tips.

source.description: The texture: a built-in pattern (cold-pressed, hot-pressed, rough, vellum, laid, ingres, sanded, canvas, linen, gesso) or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources); light parts are peaks, which paint.

mode.description: texturised (default): the grain stays put on the canvas, a texture under the paint; moving: it rolls along with the tip, turning with it.

scale.description: Grain size: 1 is the pattern's or image's own size, 2 twice as coarse (default 1).

depth.description: How much the grain takes out of each dab: 0 none, 1 only the peaks paint (default 0.6).

contrast.description: Height contrast around the middle: below 1 softer, above 1 harsher (default 1).

marks.description: How the tip is laid along the path (default continuous): continuous dabs, a scatter of spray droplets, particles, objects (editable stickers), antimatter (detonations that invert, scorch and destroy paint across every visible layer), a scraper blade that cuts down through layers, or vortex (winds surrounding paint into a vortex of the drawn shape).

oneOf.description: Dabs laid along the path (the default).
A spray (a spray can): each dab lays a seeded scatter of droplets across the tip; jitter and size come from dynamics and the tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

size.description: Droplet size as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.12).

oneOf.description: Particles that move with the pen and draw as they go. Missing fields take their defaults.

physics.description: How the particles move (default spring). string: strands dragged behind the pen (hair, fur); spring: on springs to the pen, overshooting; orbit: circling the pen (curls); flow: thrown into a swirling flow until they fade; elastic: links that stretch and snap back; fuzzy: winding strings waving out of step.

render.description: How they draw (default line). dot: a mark per step; line: a continuous line each; sequence: beads spaced along each path; ribbon: the band between neighbouring paths filled.

count.description: Particles (flow: thrown per tip of travel). Default 12.

size.description: Mark size as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its edge width (default 0.08).

spread.description: How far apart they start, as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its width (default 0.5).

stiffness.description: Spring, string and elastic stiffness: stiff follows closely, soft swings wide (default 0.4).

life.description: Flow particles: how long they live (default 0.5).

ribbonFill.description: Ribbon: fill opacity between the paths, relative to their edges (default 0.5; 0 only edges).

ribbonPairs.description: Ribbon: adjacent (default) joins each particle to its neighbour; first-last makes one band between the outermost two.

waveAmplitude.description: Wave: sideways swing as a fraction of the tip size (default 0: no wave).

waveLength.description: Wave: wavelength in px of pen travel (default 60).

wavePhaseJitter.description: Wave: how far out of step the particles' waves are; 0 in step, 1 random phases (default 0).

stampOrder.description: Stamp tips: sequence (default) uses the stamps in turn; random picks one per dot, seeded.

stampRotation.description: Stamp tips: follow turns each with its particle's motion; random (default); fixed uses the tip angle.

oneOf.description: Each mark stays an editable object (a sticker) on a sticker layer; needs a stamp tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

density.description: About density × 4 marks per tip diameter of travel; 0.25 ≈ one per diameter (default 0.4).

rotationJitter.description: Random turn as a fraction of ±180° (default 1).

scatter.description: How far from the path marks land, in tip diameters (default 0.5).

colourJitter.description: Random colour change: at 1 up to ±40° of hue and ±0.15 OKLab lightness (default 0.2).

oneOf.description: Antimatter paint: where the tip touches paint across any visible layer, it detonates — inverting colours in the core, removing alpha, burning a soot ring, denting thick relief, clearing core light, and throwing sparks on the active layer. Missing fields take their defaults.

blastSpacing.description: Stroke travel between blasts, in tip diameters (default 2).

threshold.description: Paint needed under the tip to fire (default 0.1).

invert.description: Strength of the colour inversion in the blast core (default 1).

invertMode.description: Colour inversion mode: rgb (default, channel complement) or oklab (flips lightness and hue so mid-grey changes too).

scorch.description: Strength of the soot ring around the blast (default 0.6).

annihilate.description: Paint destroyed at the centre — alpha removed, unless the layer has lockTransparency (default 0.25).

sparks.description: How many sparks fly out from each blast on the active layer (default 0.5; 0: none).

sparkReach.description: How far sparks fly, in tip diameters (default 3).

crater.description: Depth of the crater dent and raised rim on layers with thick relief (default 0.5).

duration.description: Seconds a blast plays on screen (default 0.7; 0 shows the result at once).

oneOf.description: A scraper blade that cuts down through the visible paint stack layer by layer, removing alpha and thick height and carrying leftover depth into the layer below, stopping at locked layers or the paper. Missing fields take their defaults.

depth.description: Layers removed per full-pressure pass, 0..1 (default 0.5). Any depth left after emptying the top visible layer carries into the layer below.

oneOf.description: Vortex paint: the stroke you draw is the shape of a vortex (a point whirlpool, an open racetrack, or a closed loop) that pulls in and winds surrounding paint at pen-up. Missing fields take their defaults.

reach.description: How far the vortex pulls from the stroke, in tip radii (default 3). Pressure scales the local reach.

turns.description: How far paint winds around the shape, in turns (default 1.5).

pull.description: How strongly paint is drawn inward toward the stroke: 0 pure spin, 1 strong whirlpool contraction (default 0.3).

direction.description: Winding direction: follow (default: closed loops turn the way they were drawn; open strokes and points turn clockwise), cw (clockwise) or ccw (counter-clockwise).

ink.description: How much paint colour the stroke lays before winding: 0 is colourless and only moves existing paint; > 0 lays colour and winds it (default 0).

duration.description: Seconds the view-only winding animation takes on screen; 0 shows the final result at once (default 1.2).

dynamics.description: Pen feel: pressure, tilt, velocity, jitter, rotation and smoothing. Every amount 0 (off) .. 1 unless noted; missing fields take their defaults.

pressureSize.description: Pressure scales the size, down to minSize (default true).

pressureSmoothing.description: Pressure smoothing, separate from position smoothing (default 0).

rotation.description: What turns the tip: fixed (tip.angle, default), stroke (direction of travel) or barrel (pen barrel rotation).

minSize.description: Size at zero pressure as a fraction of the full size, with pressureSize (default 0).

tiltSize.description: Laying the pen down widens the tip, up to 2.5× (default 0).

tiltRoundness.description: Laying the pen down flattens the tip along the tilt, side-of-the-pencil shading (default 0).

tiltOpacity.description: Laying the pen down lightens the mark (default 0).

velocitySize.description: Positive grows the tip on fast strokes, negative thins it; needs timed points (default 0).

velocityOpacity.description: Positive darkens fast marks, negative lightens them; needs timed points (default 0).

angleJitter.description: Random angle per dab, as a fraction of ±180° (default 0).

scatter.description: Random offset across the stroke, in diameters (default 0).

count.description: Dabs laid at each spacing step, each with its own jitter and scatter (default 1). Dab brushes.

flip.description: Mirror each dab at random across x, y or both (default none): variety for image and stamp tips.

behaviour.description: What the material does on the surface, and how tools work. Missing fields take their defaults.

surface.description: dry (default): stays where it lands; wet: flows, pools and dries (see wet); thick: stands up in relief (see thick).

grain.description: Paper grain response: 0 ignores the grain, 1 catches only its peaks at light pressure (pencil, pastel, charcoal). Default 0.

mixing.description: How colours mix: pigment (Kubelka-Munk, blue and yellow make green) or rgb (straight averages). Default pigment; a Mixer Brush and the smudge tool default to rgb.

exchange.description: Paint exchange with the canvas: picking up paint and mixing it into what the brush lays. Paint brushes on a dry, wet or thick surface and Mixer Brushes.

pickup.description: Pick-up ratio: how much of the paint under each dab the brush lifts and carries (default 0; with a reservoir 0.5).

mix.description: Mix ratio: how much of the carried paint goes into what the brush lays, against its own colour (default 0.5).

dirty.description: Keep the carried paint after the stroke, so the next one starts with the last colour touched (default false).

reservoir.description: A paint reservoir makes this a Mixer Brush (an empty object takes every default).

load.description: How much paint the reservoir holds; below 1 it drains per dab and long strokes run dry (default 0.5).

refill.description: Refill with the paint colour before each stroke (default true).

loadsColour.description: Load the current colour at all (default true; false: it only moves paint already down).

wet.description: Wet surface (watercolour, gouache, wet oil) and the wet tools. Missing fields take their defaults.

medium.description: The wet medium; a layer takes the medium's wet settings the first time it holds wet paint (default: the variety when it is watercolor, gouache or oil, else watercolor).

water.description: Wetness: water laid, 0.2 a damp brush .. 1 dripping (default 0.5).

pigment.description: Pigment concentration: 0 clear water .. 1 straight from the tube (default 0.5).

rewet.description: How much dried paint the water lifts again: 0 staining (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the brush runs dry along a long stroke (default 1).

thinner.description: Thinner (water or solvent): more transparent, runnier paint (default 0).

thick.description: Thick surface (impasto: paint with relief, lit by the canvas lighting). Missing fields take their defaults.

applicator.description: What lays the paint (default brush). brush: bristle ridges; tube: blobs squeezed from the tube; knife: scrapes the relief flat and smears; roller: a flat stippled band; gloop: a thick glossy bead.

thickness.description: How far the paint stands up (default 0.6).

metallic.description: Metallic: highlights take the paint colour, gold, copper, silver (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the stroke thins as the brush empties (default 0.9).

drag.description: Knife and brush: how much of the paint under the tool is dragged along (default 0.4).

rim.description: Light paint: light is stronger where the bead turns away, as on backlit glass (default 0).

clarity.description: Glassy paint: the middle of a bead lets the layers below show through (default 0).

strength.description: Tools: how strongly the blender, smudge or wet tool works per dab (default 0.5; smudge 0.7).

distance.description: Blender: how far away colours are mixed in, as a fraction of the tip diameter (default 0.35).

length.description: Smudge: how far paint is dragged, the share of carried paint kept per dab (default 0.85).

light.description: Light the brush gives off with its colour (glow and spill). Give light brushes dark paper.

amount.description: Light per dab, scaled by its coverage and flow (default 0: none).

spill.description: Suggested spill for the layer, applied when it has none of its own.

radius.description: How far the light reaches, px; 0 turns spill off (a highlighter).

glow.description: Suggest a glow layer effect for the layer (glow stays a layer effect).

fluorescence.description: UV-fluorescent ink: glows in its colour under the virtual UV blacklight (set_uv_light); invisible in normal light when invisible is true.

invisible.description: Invisible ink in normal light: lays no daylight paint and glows only under UV (default false).

thermochromic.description: Thermochromic ink: shifts smoothly toward hotColor where the canvas heat field warms it past threshold.

hotColor.description: Colour (#rrggbb) the ink turns when heated.

threshold.description: Temperature 0.05..0.95 at which the colour shift is halfway (default 0.5).

iridescence.description: Structural colour: a thin dielectric film over the paint whose interference hue shifts with the light and view tilt. Missing fields take their defaults.

pressureToThickness.description: How much pen pressure shifts the film thickness per dab, 0..1 (default 0: uniform thickness).

ior.description: Refractive index of the film, 1.2..2.0 (default 1.5; water/soap ~1.33, pearl ~1.55, beetle lacquer ~1.65).

ghost.description: Ghost paint: wet paint that flows and mixes visibly while wet, then fades away without leaving its colour, keeping only the smear it made in the paint it touched (needs behaviour.surface "wet").

linger.description: Seconds of simulated time before the ghost paint has fully faded (default 4).

smear.description: How much the ghost paint drags and lifts the paint it passes through: 0 none .. 1 full (default 0.3).

trigger.description: When the fade starts: immediate (default) counts down as soon as the paint is laid; agent holds the fade until read_mutation claims the stroke.

mutation.description: Mutation paint: you paint something and pause; once an agent claims it with read_mutation, your paint sinks away and the agent paints its own answer (any wet or dry paint brush that lays its own colour without reading paint beneath).

settle.description: Seconds after the last stroke before it counts as finished and raises a mutation request (default 1.5).

patience.description: Seconds to wait for an agent before giving up and keeping the paint as ordinary paint (default 45).

fade.description: Seconds the paint takes to sink away once claimed by read_mutation (default 2).

ferro.description: Liquid ferrofluid paint: 0..1 (amount), or { amount, wavelength, threshold }. Rises into glossy Rosensweig spikes near magnets until cured.

anyOf.description: How much liquid ferrofluid the brush lays per dab (0..1).
Liquid ferrofluid paint: rises into glossy Rosensweig spikes near magnets until cured.

amount.description: How much liquid ferrofluid the brush lays per dab (default 0: none).

threshold.description: Critical magnetic field |B| threshold where spikes begin to rise (default 0.12).

live.description: Effect paint keeps playing on stroke layers (default false).

fps.description: Suggested playback rate in frames per second.

waveSpeed.description: Particle waves: how fast they run by stroke time; 0 they stand still (default 0), 1 about four a second.

livePatterns.description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion patterns (spots, stripes, coral, maze, worms) that grow inside wet paint (behaviour.surface: wet) and freeze where the paint dries.

pattern.description: Named Pearson feed/kill preset: spots (default, dividing mitosis spots), stripes (labyrinthine stripes), coral (branching dendrites), maze (winding channels) or worms (vermicular tracks).

feed.description: Gray-Scott feed rate F (0.01..0.1; default from pattern).

kill.description: Gray-Scott kill rate k (0.03..0.08; default from pattern).

scale.description: Spatial scale of the pattern (diffusion multiplier, 0.5..4, default 1).

contrast.description: Visual contrast of the V concentration field (0..2, default 1).

secondColor.description: Optional second colour (#rrggbb) that V blends the wet paint towards; null or omitted modulates pigment density/contrast.

relief.description: Impasto relief height written to the layer thick map as patterns grow (0..1, default 0).

colour.description: The brush's colours. The user's colour still wins unless own is set.

default.description: The colour the brush starts with. A gradient is always painted (its paint / secondary stops take the user's colours); a solid colour or effect paint is suggested to the host.

anyOf.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).
A colour for each colour scheme; the host picks one when the stroke starts and records it.

light.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).

dark.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).

anyOf.description: Gradient paint: the brush samples it dab by dab as the stroke goes. Example (blue to yellow over 300 px of stroke, and back): { "type": "gradient", "stops": [{ "offset": 0, "color": "#1d4ed8" }, { "offset": 1, "color": "#facc15" }], "map": { "by": "distance", "length": 300, "repeat": "mirror" } }.

offset.description: Where the stop is, 0..1 along the gradient. Stops must be sorted by offset.

color.description: #rrggbb, or "paint" / "secondary": the editor's paint or second colour when the stroke starts.

opacity.description: 0..1 (default 1): multiplies the brush's flow where this colour is laid.

midpoint.description: Where between this stop and the next the colours are half mixed, 0.05..0.95 of the way (default 0.5).

space.description: How neighbouring stops mix: pigment (default; like paint, blue to yellow passes green), oklab (perceptual) or srgb (plain numbers).

map.description: What moves the stroke along the gradient (default distance, 300 px, mirror).

by.description: distance: px (or dabs) of stroke travelled; pressure: pen pressure 0..1; tilt: pen lean, upright 0 .. flat 1; velocity: pen speed, 0 .. 2.5 px/ms; direction: direction of travel, once round per 360°; time: ms since the stroke began (needs timed points); across-tip: left to right across the tip, looking along the stroke (a brush loaded with several colours); random: a random point per dab (seeded, so replays match).

length.description: distance: px of travel (or dabs, with unit "dabs") per run through the gradient (default 300).

repeat.description: distance and time: past the end, clamp (hold the last colour), repeat (start again) or mirror (run back; default for distance, clamp for time).

duration.description: time: ms per run through the gradient (default 2000).

softness.description: How softly neighbouring stops blend: 1 smooth (default) .. 0 hard steps.

anyOf.description: Effect paint: the brush paints an effect (search_effects).

provider.description: The provider's id when it was chosen.

values.description: Every control value (number, string, boolean or a number list).

time.description: Which moment of an animated effect, ms.

map.description: Lay the effect along each stroke instead of fixing it to the canvas.

length.description: Strip length: px of stroke per repeat of the effect.

repeat.description: Past the strip end: start again, run back or hold.

live.description: On a stroke layer the stroke keeps playing the effect.

items.description: A colour a brush can carry: a solid colour, a light / dark pair, a gradient or effect paint.

tools.name: update_brush
tools.title: Update a brush
tools.description: Changes a saved brush: the facets given are laid over its own (objects merge, lists and values replace; marks of another kind replace the marks), and unset removes whole facets back to their defaults. Built-in presets are refused (duplicate_brush first). Checked against this host like create_brush: a change that adds what this host can't render is refused and saves nothing, while facets the brush already had for other hosts (a paint brush's light, in canvas) are kept as they are. One change. Returns the brush, the leaf paths changed, problems, warnings and, when there are any, kept: the facets this host can't use that the brush keeps.

id.description: The saved brush to change (not a built-in).

description.description: What the brush is for, in a sentence.

items.description: A tag: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

kind.description: mark: lays a material (see medium); tool: works on paint already down (see tool).

medium.description: Marks: what it lays. paint (dry, wet or thick), ink, dry (pencil, pastel, charcoal) or spray (airbrush). Descriptive: the tip, marks and behaviour decide how it renders.

variety.description: What kind of the medium: oil, watercolor, gouache, pencil, pastel, charcoal, airbrush, marker, highlighter… A wet brush whose variety is watercolor, gouache or oil paints that medium.

tool.description: Tools: eraser removes paint; blender mixes the colours under the tip; smudge drags paint along; water lays clear water (lifts dried paint with behaviour.wet.rewet); dryer dries wet paint; blow pushes water along; blot takes wet paint up; wet-blend evens out wet pigment; wet-drag drags wet paint.

tip.description: The tip: its shape and the dab it lays. In a patch, shape may be left out to keep it.

shape.description: round, flat, chisel: an ellipse set by roundness and angle (the name is for people); bristle: a tuft of bristles (see bristle); stamp: dabs shaped like a stamp, a sticker or an image source (see stamps), also laid as sprays, objects or particles.

hardness.description: Edge hardness, 0 soft .. 1 hard (default 1). Image-source stamps fade towards their edges below 1.

spacing.description: Dab spacing as a fraction of the diameter: 0.05 smooth, 1 dotted (default 0.1).

angle.description: Tip angle in degrees, counter-clockwise; added to the stroke direction or barrel with dynamics.rotation (default 0).

roundness.description: Roundness: 1 round (default), lower a flat ellipse (pastel, chisel).

opacity.description: Stroke opacity ceiling: overlapping dabs never exceed it (default 1).

flow.description: Build-up per dab towards the opacity: low flow builds softly, like an airbrush (default 1).

blend.description: How the stroke paints onto the layer (default normal). pigment mixes like real paint; multiply darkens like marker ink; watercolor glazes; tint, highlight and shadow recolour, light and shade.

bristle.description: Bristle tips: the tuft. Missing fields take their defaults.

stiffness.description: Stiff bristles follow the tip; soft ones lag and bend into curves at turns (default 0.5).

splay.description: How far pressure spreads the tuft (default 0.5).

thickness.description: Each bristle's line width as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.06).

load.description: Paint per bristle: 1 never runs dry; lower, bristles run out along the stroke, a dry brush (default 0.6).

jitter.description: Random variation between bristles: length, paint, position (default 0.4).

items.description: A sticker ref provider:id (find_stickers lists them; the editor's own are editor:dot, editor:star, editor:heart, editor:leaf, editor:flower, editor:confetti, editor:splat, editor:sparkle, editor:ring), or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources lists them; add_brush_source makes one from an image). A bare editor stamp (star) means editor:star.

stamps.description: Stamp tips: stickers or image sources (source:<id>). Continuous dabs and sprays lay the first; objects take only stickers and pick one at random per mark (default editor:star; repeats count once); particles use the first 4 in marks.stampOrder, and repeats weight the order.

grain.description: Texture inside the tip (a grain source), separate from the paper's grain: each dab is multiplied by it. Continuous and scatter marks of round and stamp tips.

source.description: The texture: a built-in pattern (cold-pressed, hot-pressed, rough, vellum, laid, ingres, sanded, canvas, linen, gesso) or an image source source:<id> (list_brush_sources); light parts are peaks, which paint.

mode.description: texturised (default): the grain stays put on the canvas, a texture under the paint; moving: it rolls along with the tip, turning with it.

scale.description: Grain size: 1 is the pattern's or image's own size, 2 twice as coarse (default 1).

depth.description: How much the grain takes out of each dab: 0 none, 1 only the peaks paint (default 0.6).

contrast.description: Height contrast around the middle: below 1 softer, above 1 harsher (default 1).

marks.description: How the tip is laid along the path (default continuous): continuous dabs, a scatter of spray droplets, particles, objects (editable stickers), antimatter (detonations that invert, scorch and destroy paint across every visible layer), a scraper blade that cuts down through layers, or vortex (winds surrounding paint into a vortex of the drawn shape).

oneOf.description: Dabs laid along the path (the default).
A spray (a spray can): each dab lays a seeded scatter of droplets across the tip; jitter and size come from dynamics and the tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

size.description: Droplet size as a fraction of the tip size (default 0.12).

oneOf.description: Particles that move with the pen and draw as they go. Missing fields take their defaults.

physics.description: How the particles move (default spring). string: strands dragged behind the pen (hair, fur); spring: on springs to the pen, overshooting; orbit: circling the pen (curls); flow: thrown into a swirling flow until they fade; elastic: links that stretch and snap back; fuzzy: winding strings waving out of step.

render.description: How they draw (default line). dot: a mark per step; line: a continuous line each; sequence: beads spaced along each path; ribbon: the band between neighbouring paths filled.

count.description: Particles (flow: thrown per tip of travel). Default 12.

size.description: Mark size as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its edge width (default 0.08).

spread.description: How far apart they start, as a fraction of the tip size; ribbon: its width (default 0.5).

stiffness.description: Spring, string and elastic stiffness: stiff follows closely, soft swings wide (default 0.4).

life.description: Flow particles: how long they live (default 0.5).

ribbonFill.description: Ribbon: fill opacity between the paths, relative to their edges (default 0.5; 0 only edges).

ribbonPairs.description: Ribbon: adjacent (default) joins each particle to its neighbour; first-last makes one band between the outermost two.

waveAmplitude.description: Wave: sideways swing as a fraction of the tip size (default 0: no wave).

waveLength.description: Wave: wavelength in px of pen travel (default 60).

wavePhaseJitter.description: Wave: how far out of step the particles' waves are; 0 in step, 1 random phases (default 0).

stampOrder.description: Stamp tips: sequence (default) uses the stamps in turn; random picks one per dot, seeded.

stampRotation.description: Stamp tips: follow turns each with its particle's motion; random (default); fixed uses the tip angle.

oneOf.description: Each mark stays an editable object (a sticker) on a sticker layer; needs a stamp tip. Missing fields take their defaults.

density.description: About density × 4 marks per tip diameter of travel; 0.25 ≈ one per diameter (default 0.4).

rotationJitter.description: Random turn as a fraction of ±180° (default 1).

scatter.description: How far from the path marks land, in tip diameters (default 0.5).

colourJitter.description: Random colour change: at 1 up to ±40° of hue and ±0.15 OKLab lightness (default 0.2).

oneOf.description: Antimatter paint: where the tip touches paint across any visible layer, it detonates — inverting colours in the core, removing alpha, burning a soot ring, denting thick relief, clearing core light, and throwing sparks on the active layer. Missing fields take their defaults.

blastSpacing.description: Stroke travel between blasts, in tip diameters (default 2).

threshold.description: Paint needed under the tip to fire (default 0.1).

invert.description: Strength of the colour inversion in the blast core (default 1).

invertMode.description: Colour inversion mode: rgb (default, channel complement) or oklab (flips lightness and hue so mid-grey changes too).

scorch.description: Strength of the soot ring around the blast (default 0.6).

annihilate.description: Paint destroyed at the centre — alpha removed, unless the layer has lockTransparency (default 0.25).

sparks.description: How many sparks fly out from each blast on the active layer (default 0.5; 0: none).

sparkReach.description: How far sparks fly, in tip diameters (default 3).

crater.description: Depth of the crater dent and raised rim on layers with thick relief (default 0.5).

duration.description: Seconds a blast plays on screen (default 0.7; 0 shows the result at once).

oneOf.description: A scraper blade that cuts down through the visible paint stack layer by layer, removing alpha and thick height and carrying leftover depth into the layer below, stopping at locked layers or the paper. Missing fields take their defaults.

depth.description: Layers removed per full-pressure pass, 0..1 (default 0.5). Any depth left after emptying the top visible layer carries into the layer below.

oneOf.description: Vortex paint: the stroke you draw is the shape of a vortex (a point whirlpool, an open racetrack, or a closed loop) that pulls in and winds surrounding paint at pen-up. Missing fields take their defaults.

reach.description: How far the vortex pulls from the stroke, in tip radii (default 3). Pressure scales the local reach.

turns.description: How far paint winds around the shape, in turns (default 1.5).

pull.description: How strongly paint is drawn inward toward the stroke: 0 pure spin, 1 strong whirlpool contraction (default 0.3).

direction.description: Winding direction: follow (default: closed loops turn the way they were drawn; open strokes and points turn clockwise), cw (clockwise) or ccw (counter-clockwise).

ink.description: How much paint colour the stroke lays before winding: 0 is colourless and only moves existing paint; > 0 lays colour and winds it (default 0).

duration.description: Seconds the view-only winding animation takes on screen; 0 shows the final result at once (default 1.2).

dynamics.description: Pen feel: pressure, tilt, velocity, jitter, rotation and smoothing. Every amount 0 (off) .. 1 unless noted; missing fields take their defaults.

pressureSize.description: Pressure scales the size, down to minSize (default true).

pressureSmoothing.description: Pressure smoothing, separate from position smoothing (default 0).

rotation.description: What turns the tip: fixed (tip.angle, default), stroke (direction of travel) or barrel (pen barrel rotation).

minSize.description: Size at zero pressure as a fraction of the full size, with pressureSize (default 0).

tiltSize.description: Laying the pen down widens the tip, up to 2.5× (default 0).

tiltRoundness.description: Laying the pen down flattens the tip along the tilt, side-of-the-pencil shading (default 0).

tiltOpacity.description: Laying the pen down lightens the mark (default 0).

velocitySize.description: Positive grows the tip on fast strokes, negative thins it; needs timed points (default 0).

velocityOpacity.description: Positive darkens fast marks, negative lightens them; needs timed points (default 0).

angleJitter.description: Random angle per dab, as a fraction of ±180° (default 0).

scatter.description: Random offset across the stroke, in diameters (default 0).

count.description: Dabs laid at each spacing step, each with its own jitter and scatter (default 1). Dab brushes.

flip.description: Mirror each dab at random across x, y or both (default none): variety for image and stamp tips.

behaviour.description: What the material does on the surface, and how tools work. Missing fields take their defaults.

surface.description: dry (default): stays where it lands; wet: flows, pools and dries (see wet); thick: stands up in relief (see thick).

grain.description: Paper grain response: 0 ignores the grain, 1 catches only its peaks at light pressure (pencil, pastel, charcoal). Default 0.

mixing.description: How colours mix: pigment (Kubelka-Munk, blue and yellow make green) or rgb (straight averages). Default pigment; a Mixer Brush and the smudge tool default to rgb.

exchange.description: Paint exchange with the canvas: picking up paint and mixing it into what the brush lays. Paint brushes on a dry, wet or thick surface and Mixer Brushes.

pickup.description: Pick-up ratio: how much of the paint under each dab the brush lifts and carries (default 0; with a reservoir 0.5).

mix.description: Mix ratio: how much of the carried paint goes into what the brush lays, against its own colour (default 0.5).

dirty.description: Keep the carried paint after the stroke, so the next one starts with the last colour touched (default false).

reservoir.description: A paint reservoir makes this a Mixer Brush (an empty object takes every default).

load.description: How much paint the reservoir holds; below 1 it drains per dab and long strokes run dry (default 0.5).

refill.description: Refill with the paint colour before each stroke (default true).

loadsColour.description: Load the current colour at all (default true; false: it only moves paint already down).

wet.description: Wet surface (watercolour, gouache, wet oil) and the wet tools. Missing fields take their defaults.

medium.description: The wet medium; a layer takes the medium's wet settings the first time it holds wet paint (default: the variety when it is watercolor, gouache or oil, else watercolor).

water.description: Wetness: water laid, 0.2 a damp brush .. 1 dripping (default 0.5).

pigment.description: Pigment concentration: 0 clear water .. 1 straight from the tube (default 0.5).

rewet.description: How much dried paint the water lifts again: 0 staining (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the brush runs dry along a long stroke (default 1).

thinner.description: Thinner (water or solvent): more transparent, runnier paint (default 0).

thick.description: Thick surface (impasto: paint with relief, lit by the canvas lighting). Missing fields take their defaults.

applicator.description: What lays the paint (default brush). brush: bristle ridges; tube: blobs squeezed from the tube; knife: scrapes the relief flat and smears; roller: a flat stippled band; gloop: a thick glossy bead.

thickness.description: How far the paint stands up (default 0.6).

metallic.description: Metallic: highlights take the paint colour, gold, copper, silver (default 0).

load.description: Paint loading: 1 never runs out; lower, the stroke thins as the brush empties (default 0.9).

drag.description: Knife and brush: how much of the paint under the tool is dragged along (default 0.4).

rim.description: Light paint: light is stronger where the bead turns away, as on backlit glass (default 0).

clarity.description: Glassy paint: the middle of a bead lets the layers below show through (default 0).

strength.description: Tools: how strongly the blender, smudge or wet tool works per dab (default 0.5; smudge 0.7).

distance.description: Blender: how far away colours are mixed in, as a fraction of the tip diameter (default 0.35).

length.description: Smudge: how far paint is dragged, the share of carried paint kept per dab (default 0.85).

light.description: Light the brush gives off with its colour (glow and spill). Give light brushes dark paper.

amount.description: Light per dab, scaled by its coverage and flow (default 0: none).

spill.description: Suggested spill for the layer, applied when it has none of its own.

radius.description: How far the light reaches, px; 0 turns spill off (a highlighter).

glow.description: Suggest a glow layer effect for the layer (glow stays a layer effect).

fluorescence.description: UV-fluorescent ink: glows in its colour under the virtual UV blacklight (set_uv_light); invisible in normal light when invisible is true.

invisible.description: Invisible ink in normal light: lays no daylight paint and glows only under UV (default false).

thermochromic.description: Thermochromic ink: shifts smoothly toward hotColor where the canvas heat field warms it past threshold.

hotColor.description: Colour (#rrggbb) the ink turns when heated.

threshold.description: Temperature 0.05..0.95 at which the colour shift is halfway (default 0.5).

iridescence.description: Structural colour: a thin dielectric film over the paint whose interference hue shifts with the light and view tilt. Missing fields take their defaults.

pressureToThickness.description: How much pen pressure shifts the film thickness per dab, 0..1 (default 0: uniform thickness).

ior.description: Refractive index of the film, 1.2..2.0 (default 1.5; water/soap ~1.33, pearl ~1.55, beetle lacquer ~1.65).

ghost.description: Ghost paint: wet paint that flows and mixes visibly while wet, then fades away without leaving its colour, keeping only the smear it made in the paint it touched (needs behaviour.surface "wet").

linger.description: Seconds of simulated time before the ghost paint has fully faded (default 4).

smear.description: How much the ghost paint drags and lifts the paint it passes through: 0 none .. 1 full (default 0.3).

trigger.description: When the fade starts: immediate (default) counts down as soon as the paint is laid; agent holds the fade until read_mutation claims the stroke.

mutation.description: Mutation paint: you paint something and pause; once an agent claims it with read_mutation, your paint sinks away and the agent paints its own answer (any wet or dry paint brush that lays its own colour without reading paint beneath).

settle.description: Seconds after the last stroke before it counts as finished and raises a mutation request (default 1.5).

patience.description: Seconds to wait for an agent before giving up and keeping the paint as ordinary paint (default 45).

fade.description: Seconds the paint takes to sink away once claimed by read_mutation (default 2).

ferro.description: Liquid ferrofluid paint: 0..1 (amount), or { amount, wavelength, threshold }. Rises into glossy Rosensweig spikes near magnets until cured.

anyOf.description: How much liquid ferrofluid the brush lays per dab (0..1).
Liquid ferrofluid paint: rises into glossy Rosensweig spikes near magnets until cured.

amount.description: How much liquid ferrofluid the brush lays per dab (default 0: none).

threshold.description: Critical magnetic field |B| threshold where spikes begin to rise (default 0.12).

live.description: Effect paint keeps playing on stroke layers (default false).

fps.description: Suggested playback rate in frames per second.

waveSpeed.description: Particle waves: how fast they run by stroke time; 0 they stand still (default 0), 1 about four a second.

livePatterns.description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion patterns (spots, stripes, coral, maze, worms) that grow inside wet paint (behaviour.surface: wet) and freeze where the paint dries.

pattern.description: Named Pearson feed/kill preset: spots (default, dividing mitosis spots), stripes (labyrinthine stripes), coral (branching dendrites), maze (winding channels) or worms (vermicular tracks).

feed.description: Gray-Scott feed rate F (0.01..0.1; default from pattern).

kill.description: Gray-Scott kill rate k (0.03..0.08; default from pattern).

scale.description: Spatial scale of the pattern (diffusion multiplier, 0.5..4, default 1).

contrast.description: Visual contrast of the V concentration field (0..2, default 1).

secondColor.description: Optional second colour (#rrggbb) that V blends the wet paint towards; null or omitted modulates pigment density/contrast.

relief.description: Impasto relief height written to the layer thick map as patterns grow (0..1, default 0).

colour.description: The brush's colours. The user's colour still wins unless own is set.

default.description: The colour the brush starts with. A gradient is always painted (its paint / secondary stops take the user's colours); a solid colour or effect paint is suggested to the host.

anyOf.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).
A colour for each colour scheme; the host picks one when the stroke starts and records it.

light.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).

dark.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).

anyOf.description: Gradient paint: the brush samples it dab by dab as the stroke goes. Example (blue to yellow over 300 px of stroke, and back): { "type": "gradient", "stops": [{ "offset": 0, "color": "#1d4ed8" }, { "offset": 1, "color": "#facc15" }], "map": { "by": "distance", "length": 300, "repeat": "mirror" } }.

offset.description: Where the stop is, 0..1 along the gradient. Stops must be sorted by offset.

color.description: #rrggbb, or "paint" / "secondary": the editor's paint or second colour when the stroke starts.

opacity.description: 0..1 (default 1): multiplies the brush's flow where this colour is laid.

midpoint.description: Where between this stop and the next the colours are half mixed, 0.05..0.95 of the way (default 0.5).

space.description: How neighbouring stops mix: pigment (default; like paint, blue to yellow passes green), oklab (perceptual) or srgb (plain numbers).

map.description: What moves the stroke along the gradient (default distance, 300 px, mirror).

by.description: distance: px (or dabs) of stroke travelled; pressure: pen pressure 0..1; tilt: pen lean, upright 0 .. flat 1; velocity: pen speed, 0 .. 2.5 px/ms; direction: direction of travel, once round per 360°; time: ms since the stroke began (needs timed points); across-tip: left to right across the tip, looking along the stroke (a brush loaded with several colours); random: a random point per dab (seeded, so replays match).

length.description: distance: px of travel (or dabs, with unit "dabs") per run through the gradient (default 300).

repeat.description: distance and time: past the end, clamp (hold the last colour), repeat (start again) or mirror (run back; default for distance, clamp for time).

duration.description: time: ms per run through the gradient (default 2000).

softness.description: How softly neighbouring stops blend: 1 smooth (default) .. 0 hard steps.

anyOf.description: Effect paint: the brush paints an effect (search_effects).

provider.description: The provider's id when it was chosen.

values.description: Every control value (number, string, boolean or a number list).

time.description: Which moment of an animated effect, ms.

map.description: Lay the effect along each stroke instead of fixing it to the canvas.

length.description: Strip length: px of stroke per repeat of the effect.

repeat.description: Past the strip end: start again, run back or hold.

live.description: On a stroke layer the stroke keeps playing the effect.

items.description: A colour a brush can carry: a solid colour, a light / dark pair, a gradient or effect paint.

anyOf.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).
A colour for each colour scheme; the host picks one when the stroke starts and records it.

light.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).

dark.description: A solid colour: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgba(r, g, b, a).

color.description: #rrggbb, or "paint" / "secondary": the editor's paint or second colour when the stroke starts.

opacity.description: 0..1 (default 1): multiplies the brush's flow where this colour is laid.

repeat.description: distance and time: past the end, clamp (hold the last colour), repeat (start again) or mirror (run back; default for distance, clamp for time).

duration.description: time: ms per run through the gradient (default 2000).

softness.description: How softly neighbouring stops blend: 1 smooth (default) .. 0 hard steps.

anyOf.description: Effect paint: the brush paints an effect (search_effects).

provider.description: The provider's id when it was chosen.

values.description: Every control value (number, string, boolean or a number list).

time.description: Which moment of an animated effect, ms.

map.description: Lay the effect along each stroke instead of fixing it to the canvas.

length.description: Strip length: px of stroke per repeat of the effect.

repeat.description: Past the strip end: start again, run back or hold.

live.description: On a stroke layer the stroke keeps playing the effect.

own.description: The brush always paints its own colour (a rainbow marker); default false.

unset.description: Facets to remove, back to their defaults (applied before the facets given).

tools.name: add_brush_source
tools.title: Add a brush image source
tools.description: Adds an image to the brush library as a source for image tips and image grain (as Procreate's shape and grain sources). The image is a PNG data: URL; the marks are read from its transparency, its dark parts (a scan of marks on paper) or its light parts (white on black), as channel says, and kept as a grey mask at most 512 px on a side. Returns id, ref (source:<id>), the stored source's width and height, problems (the channel auto picked, scaling) and replaced. Then make the brush: create_brush or update_brush with tip { shape: "stamp", stamps: [ref] } for an image tip, or tip.grain { source: ref } for grain. A taken id is refused unless overwrite.

image.description: The image: a PNG data: URL, at most 16777216 pixels; larger than 512 px it is scaled down.

id.description: The source id (default: from the name, made unique): lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

channel.description: Where the marks are: auto (default: the transparency when the image has any, else the dark parts), alpha, darkness (dark marks on light paper) or lightness (light marks on black).

invert.description: Swap painted and empty parts (default false).

licence.description: The licence or terms the image came with, kept with the source.

origin.description: Where it came from: a file name, a pack or a URL.

overwrite.description: Replace the image of a source with the same id (default false); brushes using it change with it.

tools.name: duplicate_brush
tools.title: Duplicate a brush
tools.description: Copies any brush (built-in presets included) to a new saved brush you can change with update_brush. Returns the new id (default <id>-copy, -copy-2…) and the brush.

id.description: Brush id from list_brush_presets (lowercase letters, digits and dashes).

newId.description: Id for the copy (default <id>-copy, -copy-2…); must not be taken.

tools.name: remove_brush
tools.title: Remove a brush
tools.description: Deletes a saved brush from the library for good (export_brushes first to keep a copy). Built-in presets are refused. Returns the id removed.

id.description: The saved brush to remove (not a built-in).

tools.name: import_brushes
tools.title: Import brushes
tools.description: Adds the brushes of a library file (format pixerate-brushes version 2 from export_brushes, a version 1 file of the paint editor's brushes, which are migrated, or a bare list of brushes). Brushes with a built-in id are skipped, and so are ids already saved unless overwrite. Returns added, replaced and skipped ids and problems (each fix or skip, per brush).

file.description: The library file object, or an array of brushes.

overwrite.description: Replace saved brushes with the same id (default false: skip them).

tools.name: import_brush_pack
tools.title: Import a brush pack
tools.description: Imports a brush pack someone already owns: Photoshop .abr (sampled tips become image sources and stamp-tip brushes, computed tips round or flat brushes; preset names and spacing where the file has them) or Procreate .brush / .brushset (each brush's shape becomes its image tip and its grain its tip grain, with its name and spacing). Brushes and sources are added to the library in one import; ids already saved are skipped unless overwrite. Returns format, brushes (id, name, renderable: whether this host, Paint editor, can paint it), sources (ids), skipped, unsupported (what was not imported or mapped, in words), licence (the licence given and any licence or terms files found in the pack, also kept on each source) and problems. Packs are often licensed for personal use only: pass the licence they came with.

file.description: The pack's bytes, base64 (at most 64 MB).

fileName.description: The file name, e.g. "Inky.abr": its extension picks the format and its name prefixes the brush ids and names.

format.description: abr, brush or brushset (default: from the file name, then the contents).

prefix.description: Id prefix for the brushes and sources (default: from the file name).

licence.description: The licence or terms the pack came with, kept on every source it adds.

overwrite.description: Replace saved brushes and sources with the same ids (default false: skip them).
